name: Nice Blue
lede: Nice Blue is a strong greenish blue recorded in both a Wikipedia color list and the xkcd 2010 crowd survey, its plain, approving name left unexplained in either source.

sections.title: An unexplained compliment
sections.body:
Our library finds this name in both a Wikipedia color list and the xkcd 2010 crowd survey, but neither source explains why "nice" was the chosen word [1]. A related library entry, Blue Sapphire, is dated by Maerz and Paul to 1927 [1]. A near-duplicate name, Star Command Blue, sits only 1.3 units away, two names for almost the same blue [1]. The ISCC-NBS dictionary's nearest block is "strong greenish blue," 6.2 units from that block's centre [1].

Its nearest named neighbor is [[virgin|Virgin]], 3.0 units away and duller [2]. [[cerulean|Cerulean]] sits 3.2 units out, bluer, and [[faience|Faience]] 3.7 units out, duller [2]. Measured in LCH it reads lightness 49, chroma 37, hue 258 degrees [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Our archive finds this color in 30 of 23,781 paintings (11 by the within-painting lens), rarer than 69 percent of the named colors, as photographed [3]. It peaks in the 1800s, found in 6 of the 8,345 paintings we have from that century, 1.3 times the expected rate [3]. Inside a painting it most often plays a shadow, 36 percent of its 11 occurrences [3]. The earliest archive match dates to 1482, 528 years before the name's 2010 record in our sources; that gap marks a look-alike hue in an aged photograph, not evidence the name itself is old [3].
